What Will I Learn in the Rama Mantra Sadhana?

The Three-Phase Method: You will be guided through a specific, three-phase approach that combines Mantra Jaap(chanting), Mantra Ahuti (sacred offering), and Sadhana Tatva (ritual practice) to awaken your spiritual energy
How to Amplify Your Mantra Shakti: You will learn the focused techniques necessary to increase your mantra's power by 10 to 100 times, making it a tangible force in your life.

To Awaken Your Mantra Doota: You will discover how to activate the "Mantra Doot" that empower your chants, ensuring your efforts are truly effective and that your mantra's effects are no longer diminished.
Through disciplined practice, you will learn how to make your chants "sit" within your body and mind, overcoming common distractions and lack of concentration.
A Sacred & Secret Practice: The detailed method, including the powerful Sankalpa, will be revealed to you on a dedicated platform, ensuring the purity and sanctity of the sadhana.
Practical Guidance from Dr. Parikshit Ghotia

Benefits of Ram Mantra Sadhana
Amplified Mantra Power: Your mantra shakti will increase 10 to 100 times, making every chant more potent.
Awakened Aura: Your personal energy field will be so strong that others will feel its impact.
Effective Chanting: The mantras you chant will sit within you and become a powerful tool for your spiritual and worldly life.
Blessings of Divine Beings: When Lord Rama's grace is with you, the blessings of all gods and goddesses will follow.

Who Can Join This Sadhana?
Any Ashaeiynn member can join this sacred sadhana, regardless of their background or current spiritual practice.
This sadhana is a powerful remedy for anyone who feels their mantra chanting is not effective. It’s especially for those who:
Find it difficult to focus while chanting.
Feel their chants don't have a lasting effect.
Are unable to use their mantra for practical purposes.
Believe their mantra shakti is weak or dormant.
Aspirants who wish to develop spiritual strength and enhance their sadhana outcomes.
Why Choose Rama Mantra Sadhana?
This sadhana is more than just a spiritual practice; it is a profound and direct solution for anyone seeking to make their mantra a tangible, living force.
Unlike a general sadhana, the Rama Mantra Sadhana is a unique and guru-guided program with a single, powerful focus: to completely transform your relationship with your mantra.
Mantra is the key, but the sadhana is the lock-pick. It will not just transform your chant, but the very aura of your life."
Registration Fee: ₹3,100 for 09 days.
FAQ'S
1. Who is this sadhana for?

This sadhana is for anyone who feels their mantra chanting is not as effective as they’d like. If you struggle with focus, feel like your mantra’s energy fades quickly, or believe its power is weak, this practice is specifically designed for you.
2. How is this sadhana different from other chanting practices?

This is a unique, guru-guided sadhana with a specific goal: to activate your mantra’s power by 10 to 100 times. We focus on a sacred, three-phase method that includes Mantra Jaap, Mantra Ahuti, and a special Sadhana Tattva to awaken your Mantra Doots.
3. Do I need to have a previous spiritual practice to join?
No, this sadhana is designed for both beginners and experienced practitioners. All you need is a sincere desire to make your mantra more powerful and an open heart.
4. Will the sadhana be held online or in person?
This is an online sadhana. Upon registration, you will be given access to a dedicated platform where all instructions, materials, and guidance will be shared.
5. Who will guide us during the Rama Mantra sadhana?

The sadhana will be led by Dr. Parikshit Ghotia, the founder of Ashaeiynn & Mentors. They will personally perform sadhana alongside participants and provide guidance, invoking blessings from Gurudev Hanuman Ji Maharaj and Lord Rama.
6. Is there any support available during the sadhana?
Yes, you will receive ongoing support and guidance from the Ashaeiynn team and Dr. Parikshit Ghotia during the course to address any questions or challenges you may face.
7. How can I enroll in the Rama Mantra sadhana?
You can enroll by visiting our website, and after that filling out the registration form available in the Ashaeiynn App.
